article_notes: Retrospective analysis of two Onderstepoort B. rossi cohorts (2011-2013 cytokine cohort, n=96; 2014 lymphocyte cohort, n=44); both cohorts are reported elsewhere (Goddard et al. cytokine study and a lymphocyte subset study), so dogs overlap with those articles. 140 infected dogs: 15 non-survivors, 125 survivors; outcome to discharge, death or euthanasia for poor prognosis. Admission samples before treatment. Correlations of MPXI with cytokines within the non-survivor and survivor groups are within-group correlations, not severity associations, and were not extracted. Biochemistry and cytokine results per group are only in the Supplementary Material.
